quiz.question: Why use a List instead of multiple individual variables like user1, user2, user3?

answers.answer: It automatically makes the app run faster.
It converts all values to strings.
It prevents null values everywhere in your program.
It keeps related values together in one variable, making code cleaner and easier to manage.

quiz.question: Which declaration ensures the List can only contain String values?
When declaring a collection in Dart, what two things can you define?

answers.answer: The variable name and the amount of memory it uses
The file path and the import alias
The type of collection (e.g., List) and the type of each entry (e.g., String)
The print format and the debug level
